game_concept: A tower defense set in Mt. Pyre – Pyre Summit, the roaring summit: the volcanologist must handle fire sprites while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – String Glue: Concatenate string pieces to forge passwords and spell names.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Pyre Summit: the roaring summit
core_gameplay_loop: In Pyre Summit, repeat each round: Concatenate string pieces to forge passwords and spell names. Each round, fire sprites strike the obsidian gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the spell_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the obsidian gate from fire sprites in Pyre Summit: keep the spell_ok meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 43-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: spell_ok drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 43-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 9 (extended tier): String Glue
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'String Glue' (Week 2 slot 7), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Pyre Summit'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how spell_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against fire sprites in Pyre Summit.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 43 seconds while spell_ok > 0.
